scope: Offline structural validation of existing passive trace files and native run receipts. No native invocation, data fetch, estimator setting, accuracy/conditioning threshold or cause claim.
provenance: All inputs are committed in the parent PR141. Default and unchanged KITTI07-selected plane-check settings were used for those short MCD compatibility runs;00 influenced the earlier diagnosis. This tool selects no estimator setting.

validation.unit: Adversarial tests for truncation/trailing data, input versus estimator indices, run mixing/native exit, explicit nonfinite values versus JSON NaN, support/matrix/flag corruption, extreme integer, schema/duplicate keys, native summary and exclusive output.
validation.corpus: Run CLI on all three committed trace/summary/receipt tuples and retain outputs/hashes/commands. Synthetic invalid cases: no end, data after end, footer mismatch, raw NaN, mixed-run receipt, failed-native receipt, and wrong method frame count. Expect exit1 and no report for each.
validation.preservation: All native sources/CMake and previous results/publication are byte-identical to base. Original177 sources, binary pins and worker seals stay frozen.
validation.required_checks: All Python tests and3generators, showcase/leaderboard/paper-ready, source/evidence/publication and whitespace checks. No local native rebuild/rerun for this Python-only change; exact-head CI also runs the native suite.

limits: Validation establishes record/run consistency, not motion quality, matrix conditioning, binary/input authenticity or correct GT alignment. An empty-input skip remains explicit and makes inherited accuracy fields unsuitable without GT remapping. No full KITTI failure trace or cause finding.
revision: Reject an unattempted iteration unless it is the final insufficient-pairs stop. Initial closed checks remain in evidence; extended current-source results are stored separately.
